summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Leads were located for technical-assistance programmes relevant to the platform's gaps: IMF capacity development (2026 staff report CD content; SARTTAC regional centre and annual report), ADB's country knowledge plan and linked non-lending programme under the CPS 2025-2029, World Bank ASA/TA under the CPF FY2025-2031, WTO post-graduation LDC-specific TA and TFA category C capacity-building, UNDP and ESCAP support to the Smooth Transition Strategy, UNCTAD investment-policy review follow-up, and the MoF AMIS register as a Nepal-official cross-check. No programme details were retrieved; the inventory and the mapping of TA to platform data gaps are pending. The platform does not contact any provider.

findings.claim: Q1 IMF capacity development for Nepal: active TA areas (statistics, PFM, revenue, monetary/financial supervision) and delivery channels (HQ, SARTTAC).
findings.note: CD annex of 2026 staff report E04; SARTTAC annual reports E01-E03 (latest FY to locate).

findings.claim: Q1 ADB TA to Nepal: active knowledge and support TA and planned knowledge products under the CPS 2025-2029.
findings.note: Country knowledge plan E05, linked documents E06, project list E07.

findings.claim: Q1 World Bank ASA/TA: planned analytics and trust-funded TA under the CPF FY2025-2031.
findings.note: CPF E08 annexes; country page E09.

findings.claim: Q1 LDC-transition and trade TA: WTO/EIF post-graduation TA, TFA category C support, UNDP/ESCAP STS support, UNCTAD investment-policy TA.
findings.note: E10-E14; availability after graduation depends on the UN graduation date (26C).

findings.claim: Q1 Mapping of TA to platform data gaps (national accounts rebasing, BoP/remittance corridors, debt statistics, trade by partner, labour migration statistics).
findings.note: Requires retrieval of E04, E05, E08 and MoF AMIS E15 project lists; mapping done in r2.

findings.claim: A TA programme is 'relevant to the platform's gaps' if its stated objective addresses a data or institutional gap recorded in any agent's data_gaps (statistics, PFM, debt, trade, migration, LDC transition). The platform itself does not seek, request or contact any TA provider; this inventory is research only.

data_gaps: Latest SARTTAC annual report (FY2025 or later) not located.
ADB TA project list for Nepal not exported.
World Bank trust-fund TA list not located.
EIF Nepal project pages not located (search budget exhausted).
Bilateral TA (e.g. JICA, FCDO, USAID successor arrangements, KOICA) not covered in r1 - require MoF AMIS.

assumptions.text: Relevance criterion: TA objective matches a recorded platform data/institutional gap; relevance is a research classification, not an endorsement or request.

challenges.text: Collate data_gaps across agents into a single list so 26E can map TA programmes to them in r2.

uncertainty: High. Inventory is lead-level only; TA programmes change frequently and some (LDC-specific) are contingent on the graduation date.
